{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABYxCyVA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhCWVnY", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 43, "title": "Add a safe in-app “初期状態に戻す” factory reset for the local PC-VAN world", "body": "## Problem

The only reliable way to start over as a first-time PC-VAN visitor is currently to clear the browser's site data or use a private window. That path is difficult to discover and can delete unrelated site storage and downloaded AI weights. The existing **Settings → JSON バックアップ・復元** panel supports export/restore and conditionally populating an empty older community, but there is **no straightforward "初期状態に戻す" control**.

A user wants to reset the local simulation and immediately see its original ten regulars and thirty seeded messages again, without browsing developer tools or changing browser settings.

## Expected outcome

Add a **「初期状態に戻す」** button under **設定 / Options → JSON バックアップ・復元** (or its adjacent local-data controls), with a clear destructive-action confirmation and backup option.

After confirmed reset, this same browser/tab behaves like a genuinely new PC-VAN visit: the normal MAIN entry screen, ten default fictional profiles, two writable forums (MITI 資料室 and DAISIZEN 自然の森／ＦＲＥＥ), thirty prewritten messages in eight threads, fresh local-only settings, no locally created human account or extra posts, no unread/history carryover, and the model setup invitation requiring fresh consent. A successful reset does **not** require an AI model, WebGPU, downloading anything or clearing the entire browser origin.

## Context

Current `main` (reinspect before implementing):

- `src/storage/controls.ts` renders the Settings **JSON バックアップ・復元** and initial-world provenance controls, with existing JSON export and confirmed replace-all restore; the reset belongs with them, **not** in the terminal transcript or historical MAIN menu.
- `src/storage/repository.ts`: `LocalRepository` uses IndexedDB `members`, `sigs`, `forums`, `posts`, `readStates`, `settings` and `session`. `readActivity()` detects a pristine world (including a missing `community-world` row and absent `session/imported` marker) and seeds all ten residents/boards/thirty posts. `populateCommunity()` uses `fictional-community-v1`. `replaceFromJson()` clears stores atomically but marks the world imported, so **do not implement reset by restoring an empty backup**—that intentionally remains empty.
- `src/storage/community.ts` derives thirty stable `local-seed:fictional` posts and creation-relative dates; `src/ai/personas.ts` defines the original ten identities. Reuse the same bootstrap code/path to create a new local world rather than duplicating or diverging from its fixture.
- `src/main.ts` holds active connection/controller state, terminal transcript, command history, AI model worker, scheduled AI work, active composer and a serialized repository queue. Restore calls `ai.invalidate()`, refreshes content and reconnect/session metadata. Reset must also update the **live UI** to a clean MAIN session, not just clear IndexedDB while leaving stale screens or local profiles in memory.
- `src/ai/setup.ts` provides the explicit model-load consent UI. After reset, automatic resident activity returns to its **new-world default ON**, but model-download consent is cleared. Cached heavyweight model assets and the app-shell cache are **separate browser-managed storage**, not part of the local-world factory reset.
- Already-existing JSON backups can restore the previous world after reset; their backup format and provenance must continue to work.
- Follow [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/AGENTS.md), [Issue template](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/issue.md), and [development flow](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md). Issue/PR/docs text in English; user-facing application copy in Japanese.

### User experience

In Settings → JSON バックアップ・復元 (a destructive-action subsection is fine):

- **初期状態に戻す**
- Explain plainly: *「このブラウザーに保存した投稿・会員・既読・AIの活動設定・表示設定・履歴を削除し、最初の30件の投稿がある状態に戻します。この操作は取り消せません。」*
- Make **JSON バックアップを保存** readily accessible before proceeding; do not silently create/download a backup or force one if the user explicitly chooses reset.
- Require an explicit second confirmation naming the destructive reset action (prefer a clear confirmation dialog; Cancel/Escape must do nothing). A prompt that looks like ordinary connection confirmation is insufficient.
- Report success/failure in Settings, keeping terminal content immersive and free of reset mechanics. After success, show the fresh MAIN screen (or safely reload into it).

**Reset scope:** Reset the PC-VAN IndexedDB local world, including human and AI-generated posts, all local members, AI profile edits and activity/consent/deferral state, forum/read states, settings/preferences and session/command history. Recreate precisely the normal new-world baseline. **Preserve** the optional app-shell service worker cache and already downloaded WebLLM model cache by default; they should neither be assumed to exist nor silently erased. Clearing cached weights/site-wide storage should remain a separate browser operation. A cached model must not bypass fresh download/AI processing consent.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] A keyboard-accessible **「初期状態に戻す」** action is discoverable under Settings → JSON バックアップ・復元/local-data controls, not in period-style terminal menus. The UI clearly identifies the full extent of irreversible local data loss and offers the existing JSON backup action.
- [ ] Cancel, Escape, clicking away or declining confirmation produces **zero mutations** to local posts, identities, profiles, activity state, history, caches and displayed session. No model downloads, external calls or destructive actions occur just from viewing the reset button.
- [ ] A confirmed reset clears the PC-VAN IndexedDB data and recreates the **same first-visit fixture** (ten unchanged default residents, two forums, thirty coherent seed posts/eight threads and valid `community-world` provenance) in an atomic or equivalently failure-safe repository operation. It must not create an imported-empty world, duplicate any starter posts, or merely empty the forum list.
- [ ] Fresh world defaults are restored: no old human user or human/AI-generated posts, no read markers or custom forum/profile edits, terminal preferences reset, no previous session/command history, resident auto-activity ON with the conservative default cap but no automatic-model consent or dismissed-onboarding marker; the AI invitation behaves like it does on first visit.
- [ ] After reset, the **current tab** returns to normal MAIN navigation with refreshed forum lists/author display, clean terminal/session/command history, restored default display options and no stale composer/reply target, popup, loading progress or generated draft. A normal new session can then be used without manually reloading the site, or the UI intentionally performs one safe reload into a fresh initial session.
- [ ] Cancel/stop existing AI downloads/inference, invalidate pending setup dialogs and scheduled runs, prevent late results from committing to the reset world and avoid accidental auto-load without fresh consent. If another tab is open, coordinate or signal a refresh/invalidated model state; stale tabs must not resurrect old posts or settings after reset. Handle IndexedDB concurrency/rollback and storage errors without claiming success or leaving an incoherent partially cleared world.
- [ ] The reset is scoped only to PC-VAN's local simulation repository: preserve separate downloaded WebLLM weight cache and app-shell/offline service-worker caches, and do not invoke `caches.keys()` removal, `StorageManager` site-wide deletion, clear all site data, or delete unrelated origin data. Distinguish reset vs browser site-data deletion in the docs.
- [ ] Preserve all existing JSON backup/export and atomic restore flows; a pre-reset backup can still restore the old world afterward, including previously stored posts/settings (restore semantics and the `imported` marker remain correct).
- [ ] Add deterministic repository and browser interaction tests for cancel/no-op, reset after manual+AI posts and settings changes, exact freshly seeded count/content/provenance, new session and settings state, idempotency of subsequent reloads, repeated explicit resets, mid-generation cancel/late results, error/rollback, multi-tab consistency and restoring an old JSON backup. Run `npm test` / relevant build; report actual results.
- [ ] Update README/local storage instructions with the new in-app reset path, irreversible data-loss warning, backup advice, reset/caches distinction and how to check the newly restored posts using `J MITI` → `3` → `9` → `LIST` / `READ 1`.

## Optional validation

Manual first-time experience check: reset a profile with extra posts and settings, observe the clean MAIN and original seeded threads without deleting browser caches; then restore the saved JSON backup. Useful but not a mandatory pre-merge gate.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. Reset, storage atomicity and terminal behavior can be validated against the local production build before merging.
